purpose: Use only these two standing benchmarks alongside future BayesFolio portfolio comparisons, superseding the five-benchmark reporting preference.

shared_policy.return_accounting: same dates, realized total returns and cash RF convention as the BayesFolio comparison
shared_policy.comparison_risk: report realized risk differences; do not impose BayesFolio-specific allocation constraints on standalone benchmarks

schwab_aggressive.label: Charles Schwab aggressive ETF proxy
schwab_aggressive.cash_return: shared realized risk-free proxy, not a verified Schwab sweep rate
schwab_aggressive.weight_updates: Use only verified publication and effective dates, at the first eligible monthly rebalance; never invent annual changes or backfill future announcements. Preserve sealed schedules by versioning any revision.

momentum_top7.label: Simple momentum ranking
momentum_top7.definition: Original standalone momentum benchmark from the five-benchmark suite, not the GP-covariance-matched diagnostic.
momentum_top7.universe: same approved ETF investment universe as the BayesFolio comparison; currently the 15 ETFs in CURRENT_BASELINES.json
momentum_top7.selection: highest momentum scores, with alphabetical ticker tie-breaking
momentum_top7.all_scores_negative: still hold the highest-ranked seven; no added cash-timing rule

matched_momentum.role: optional signal-attribution diagnostic only, not a standing independent benchmark

preservation: Do not delete or rewrite existing five-benchmark results, matched diagnostics, or current GP baselines.
execution_note: This records the future reporting policy. The sealed benchmark_suite_v1 runner remains an unchanged historical five-benchmark implementation; future comparison implementations must honor active_benchmark_ids rather than automatically reporting all five. No new backtest is requested by this decision.
